policy: Release certification is earned from ordered evidence. Static source signals and legacy scores never certify a game.

scenarios: Start from the Korean route and steer left and right while auto-fire advances score and wave feedback.
Survive through three hits and confirm the debrief names the last damage cause, kill count, score, and personal best.
Retry the same sector, observe the PB ghost cue, pause and continue immediately, then mute audio.
findings: No horizontal overflow at 390px; the canvas, HUD, controls, and debrief remain inside the viewport.
Production preview held 60 FPS during the sampled run and emitted no console warnings or errors.
The first run ended quickly without active steering, but the explicit missed-enemy cause and same-sector retry make the failure actionable.

craftReview.note: The mobile loop communicates movement, auto-fire, damage cause, PB ghost, and same-seed retry clearly; weapon upgrades and deterministic replay add depth beyond a disposable shooter skin.
